deps.edn.reason: The git floors and pins on repositories that are bundled here become local roots so the same namespaces are not loaded twice. The other sections are unchanged. JVM-only Maven dependencies and aliases are removed (alias :datomic, alias :dev, alias :roundtrip, alias :gen, alias :shadow, alias :test reduced to :extra-paths, alias :lint): the official CD/CI path is Amu selfhost and Kotoba native, and any other runner is an oracle that is not part of the package.

nbb.edn.reason: The same git floors as deps.edn are resolved through the bundled libraries by kbb from lib/; the file keeps only the paths.

split: Split (JUN-649): only src/kami/fsm.cljk, src/kami/gpu.cljk, src/kami/ipc.cljk stay here, because kotoba libraries require them; the rest of the library moved to kotoba-lang/kami-engine packages/kami-engine-sdk, and imports.json lists only the files held here.
